name: Animated Delete Button
useWhen: A project needs a compact destructive-action button where the trash icon animates on click and resolves into a clear completed state.
source: User-provided WhatsApp screenshot of an animated delete button clip with partial visible HTML/SVG structure.
implementationNotes: Use only after confirmation when the action is truly destructive or irreversible.
Animate on click, not on page load.
Disable duplicate clicks while the action is pending.
Use server-confirmed success before showing permanent deleted state in production.
Keep animation short and provide reduced-motion behavior.
reducedMotion: Skip the trash/paper animation and update the label/state immediately after the action resolves.
avoid: triggering destructive work without confirmation when needed
